question.worked_solution:
We use the central difference approximation

$$
{f}^{′}(x)≈\frac{f(x+h)-f(x-h)}{2h}
$$

 
at the point $x=2$ with the step size $h=0.1.$ This gives

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & ≈\frac{f(x+h)-f(x-h)}{2h} \\ {f}^{′}(2) & ≈\frac{f(2+0.1)-f(2-0.1)}{2(0.1)} \\  & =\frac{f(2.1)-f(1.9)}{0.2} \\  & =\frac{5.81-4.21}{0.2} \\  & =\frac{1.6}{0.2} \\  & =8.\end{aligned}
$$
